questions.stem: If $\overrightarrow{PQ} = 3\mathbf{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{PR} = 6\mathbf{a}$, what can you conclude about the points $P$, $Q$, and $R$?

options.text: They are collinear (lie on the same straight line)

questions.explanation: Since $\overrightarrow{PR} = 6\mathbf{a} = 2 \times 3\mathbf{a} = 2\overrightarrow{PQ}$, the vectors $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ and $\overrightarrow{PR}$ are parallel and share point $P$, so $P$, $Q$, $R$ are collinear. Also $\overrightarrow{PQ} = \frac{1}{2}\overrightarrow{PR}$, so $Q$ is the midpoint of $PR$.
